Subject: Earlier Sunday Hours Starting October 6

Hello neighbors,

Beginning October 6, our doors will open at 10 am on Sundays. We made this change after hearing from local shift workers who finish early and want a welcoming spot before heading home. Feel free to drop in anytime after ten, say hello, and enjoy a quiet morning with us.

Subject: Earlier weekend doors for shift schedules

Beginning October 6, our Sunday opening moves to 10 am so shift workers coming off duty or preparing for the week have an easier window to visit. Drop in whenever your schedule lines up and enjoy a quiet morning with the community.
